points.title: 出生与成长
points.description: 王羲之出生于琅琊临沂，这是他的故乡。在这里，他度过了他的童年和青少年时期，受到了良好的家庭教育。他的父亲王旷是当时的名士，对王羲之的书法产生了深远的影响。王羲之在这里开始学习书法，并展现出了非凡的天赋。他的书法作品《兰亭序》被认为是他最杰出的作品之一，也是中国书法史上的经典之作。
points.descriptionEn: Wang Xizhi was born in Langya Linyi, his hometown. Here, he spent his childhood and adolescence, receiving a good home education. His father, Wang Kang, was a famous scholar of the time, who had a profound influence on Wang Xizhi's calligraphy. Wang Xizhi began to learn calligraphy here and showed extraordinary talent. His calligraphy work 'Lanting序' is considered one of his greatest works and a classic in the history of Chinese calligraphy.

points.title: 仕途与书法成就
points.description: 王羲之在会稽山阴开始了他的仕途生涯，担任过多个官职。在这里，他不仅致力于政治事务，还深入研究书法艺术。他的书法风格独特，被誉为‘书圣’。他的书法作品《快雪时晴帖》和《十七帖》等都是这一时期的代表作。王羲之的书法对后世产生了深远的影响，被后人尊为‘书圣’。
points.descriptionEn: Wang Xizhi began his political career in Huiji Shanyin, holding various official positions. Here, he was not only committed to political affairs but also deeply studied the art of calligraphy. His calligraphy style was unique and was hailed as the 'Sage of Calligraphy'. His calligraphy works such as 'Quick Snow and Sunny Weather' and 'Seventeen Posts' are representative works of this period. Wang Xizhi's calligraphy had a profound influence on later generations and was revered as the 'Sage of Calligraphy'.

points.title: 晚年与逝世
points.description: 王羲之晚年居住在建康，这是东晋的都城。在这里，他继续从事书法创作，并参与了一些政治活动。他的书法作品《兰亭序》就是在建康完成的。王羲之在建康逝世，享年59岁。他的书法成就和人格魅力使他成为了中国书法史上的传奇人物。
points.descriptionEn: Wang Xizhi spent his later years in Jiankang, the capital of the Eastern Jin Dynasty. Here, he continued to engage in calligraphy creation and participated in some political activities. His famous calligraphy work 'Lanting序' was completed in Jiankang. Wang Xizhi died in Jiankang at the age of 59. His calligraphic achievements and personal charm made him a legendary figure in the history of Chinese calligraphy.

appraisal.zh: 王羲之在中国书法史上地位崇高，被后世尊为「书圣」，其书风对历代影响深远，这一称号本身即反映他在中国文化中的分量。不过也有研究者指出，他的书法或过于讲求形式之美，于实用价值有所轻忽。总体而言，其典范地位在学界与大众文化中均少受动摇。
appraisal.en: Wang Xizhi holds a towering place in the history of Chinese calligraphy, revered by later ages as the 'Sage of Calligraphy'; his style shaped generations of practitioners, and the title itself reflects his weight in Chinese culture. Yet some researchers note that his calligraphy may prize formal beauty at the expense of practical use. On the whole, his canonical standing is little shaken in either scholarship or popular culture.

supporter.zh: 王羲之被誉为‘书圣’，他的书法成就和人格魅力使他成为了中国书法史上的传奇人物。他的书法作品对后世产生了深远的影响，被后人尊为‘书圣’。
supporter.en: Wang Xizhi is hailed as the 'Sage of Calligraphy', and his calligraphic achievements and personal charm have made him a legendary figure in the history of Chinese calligraphy. His calligraphy works have had a profound influence on later generations and are revered as the 'Sage of Calligraphy'.

critic.zh: 王羲之的书法虽然成就卓越，但也存在一些争议。有人认为他的书法过于追求形式美，忽视了书法的实用价值。
critic.en: Although Wang Xizhi's calligraphy is outstanding, there are some controversies. Some people believe that his calligraphy is too concerned with formal beauty and ignores the practical value of calligraphy.

objective.zh: 王羲之是中国书法史上的重要人物，他的书法风格对后世产生了深远的影响。在历史学界和大众文化中，他被定义为‘书圣’，这一称号也反映了他在中国文化中的重要地位。
objective.en: Wang Xizhi is an important figure in the history of Chinese calligraphy, and his calligraphic style has had a profound influence on later generations. In the academic and popular culture, he is defined as the 'Sage of Calligraphy', which reflects his important position in Chinese culture.

self.zh: 吾书比之钟繇，钟繇当抗手，张芝草圣，吾不虚让。
self.en: My calligraphy is comparable to that of Zhong Yao, Zhong Yao should be a match for me, Zhang Zhi is the 'Sage of Grass Calligraphy', and I do not claim to be inferior.
